newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX BRENT UNTRADED, SUPPORT LEVEL BROKEN.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX BRENT UNTRADED, SUPPORT LEVEL BROKEN.

text.p: September Brent futures were untraded at midday on Friday, but were assessed softer after prices broke support levels.
September Brent on SIMEX was offered at $18.94 per barrel, without any bids seen.
Brent in London closed at $18.90, after falling 30 cents.
Brokers in Singapore were cautious of the direction of the market, but said they expected prices to fall further after falling below the $19.00 support level.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded at $20.04 per barrel, after New York lost 37 cents per barrel to close at $20.09.
